title: Bali Retreat | Round Trip Flight Inclusive Deal From Delhi
highlights: Admire the breathtaking views of Mount Batur and its serene volcanic lake, offering a scenic escape amidst Bali's lush, mountainous landscapes.
Witness the stunning Tanah Lot Temple, dramatically perched on a rocky outcrop, offering panoramic sunset views and a spiritual connection to the sea.
Explore Uluwatu Temple, majestically perched on a cliff, offering sweeping ocean views and a glimpse into Bali’s spiritual and cultural depth.
Rejuvenate with an authentic Balinese spa experience, combining traditional techniques and natural oils to promote relaxation, balance, and serenity.
Discover Bali’s natural beauty as you journey through its beaches, majestic waterfalls, and rice terraces nestled in scenic landscapes.
overview:
About the Tour:
Bali is a favourite destination for honeymooners around the world, and it’s easy to see why. From its endless idyllic beaches, captivating spiritual energy, colourful coral reefs, and serene waterfalls to adventurous water sports, majestic temples, rice paddies, and exotic sunsets, there is so much to see and experience in this magnificent tropical paradise.
Witness the charming views of the resting boats and the colourful sky reflecting upon the golden sand while you cruise over the pristine waters near Tanjung Benoa harbour. The sunset views from Uluwatu Temple and the pleasing sound of the gushing water at Tegenungan Waterfall are simply unparalleled experiences.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai International Airport, you’ll be transferred to your hotel. Check in and spend the day at your leisure. You can visit Garuda Wisnu Kencana, a cultural park known for its massive statue of the Hindu god Vishnu. Then, explore Bali Bird Park, home to over 1,000 exotic birds. If you’re in the mood for fun, you can spend the day at Waterbom Waterpark, famous for its thrilling water slides. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kintamani Highlands with Tegalalang Rice Terraces and Tegenungan Waterfall Tour
days.desc: Today, get ready to explore Bali's iconic attraction, the Kintamani Highlands. Take in the stunning views of Mount Batur, an active volcano surrounded by lush landscapes. You can then visit Tegenungan Waterfalls, known for its cascading beauty and perfect photo spots. Next, head to the Tegallalang Rice Terraces, where you can enjoy the scenic views and try the popular Bali Swing. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Bedugul Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Prepare for an exciting day as you set off to explore the wonders of Bedugul. You can start by visiting the iconic Handara Gate, known for its striking Balinese architecture and surrounded by scenic mountains. Next, visit Ulun Danu Temple by Lake Bratan, dedicated to Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati, offering picturesque views. Finally, you can catch a stunning sunset at Tanah Lot Temple, perched on a rock by the sea. Afterward, you'll be driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: South Bali Sightseeing Tour | Transfer to Kuta
days.desc: After checking out of your hotel, you'll be transferred to Kuta. En route, make a stop to explore Tanjung Benoa Beach, famous for its water sports such as parasailing and jet skiing. Continue to Uluwatu Temple, perched on 70-meter-high cliffs, offering breathtaking views of the Indian Ocean. In the evening, enjoy the Kecak dance and fire show, a traditional Balinese performance. Later, check in at your hotel in Kuta for an overnight stay.

days.title: Leisure Day in Kuta
days.desc: Today, you can spend the day at your leisure. You can wander through Kuta Square, known for its vibrant local crafts and souvenirs. Relax on the pristine sands of Karma Beach or Kedonganan Beach, famous for their breathtaking sunsets and tranquil ambiance. Discover the Vihara Dharmayana Temple, a historic site with intricate architecture. Enjoy local flavors and beachside views. Later, head back to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Balinese Spa and Candlelight Dinner
days.desc: Enjoy a relaxing day starting with a visit to a Balinese spa in Kuta, known for its soothing treatments and traditional massage techniques. Next, you can explore Kuta Art Market, where vibrant local crafts and souvenirs await. You can visit the Kuta Theater for captivating performances showcasing Balinese culture. Afterward, head to Jimbaran Beach for a serene coastal experience. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay. In the evening, enjoy a romantic candlelight dinner.
